description: getDisk and listDisks return activeDataBytes and totalDataBytes once a disk holds data (live: after writing an 8 MiB file, getDisk answered activeDataBytes 0 and totalDataBytes 8396800; an empty disk answers neither). @archildata/api-types 0.0.81 declares both. The spec omits them and lists dataSize, which the live API does not send.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Active data size in bytes (data in the high-speed cache). Absent until the disk holds data.
Total logical data written to the disk, in bytes. Absent until the disk holds data.
